changelog: The client installer card now reports what the installer is actually configured with. It read the FQDN from an environment variable and paired it with the web UI port (55414), while installers are built for UrBackup's internet_server on internet_server_port (55415) — so the address shown to the user was never the one the client connects on.

The address and port are now read from UrBackup's own settings, the same source the installer is built from. They cannot drift apart, and an install that never set URBACKUP_SERVER_FQDN gets the correct address automatically instead of an auto-detected LAN IP. The environment variable is still honoured as a fallback.
Includes 3.2.111: client installers scoped per endpoint, so read-only users can install agents on their own endpoints.

Includes 3.2.105-3.2.110: user roles scoped to customers (issue #21), immediate effect for user removal and role changes, migrations shipped through the update channel, Bare Metal Restore scoped per endpoint, VHD export fixed, and unrestorable images kept out of the restore picker.
